title: Demand sensing & planning
description: Forecasts demand per SKU and per outlet and plans replenishment centrally.
enablers: Supra logistics platform; machine-learning demand forecasting; automated replenishment

title: Raw material procurement
description: Buys agricultural inputs (anchovy; chilli; soybean; wheat flour; coffee beans; sugar) plus packaging from domestic and imported suppliers.
enablers: Supplier quality programs; scale purchasing across the Masan ecosystem
kpi: Input cost per unit; supplier on-time rate

title: Manufacturing
description: Produces seasonings; noodles; beverages; coffee and home care at 14 factories across North and South Vietnam.
enablers: FSSC 22000 / ISO / HACCP certified plants; vertical integration from raw material to finished goods

title: Distribution & logistics
description: Moves goods from factories to distributors and outlets; Direct Coverage cuts intermediary layers.
enablers: Direct Coverage model; sales-route redesign by region; automated ordering
kpi: Outlets covered; wholesale share; fill rate

title: Point of sale
description: Reaches consumers through general trade; modern trade (incl. WinCommerce); on-premise; e-commerce and export.
enablers: Retail Supreme / ASO membership app; WinCommerce synergy; Global Business

title: Feedback & insight loop
description: Captures sell-out and consumer data to refine assortment; innovation and production plans.
enablers: Consumer Innovation Centre; R&D centres; digital membership data
